spec: single 2-layer NP-140F (Tg135, datasheet-spec er~4.1) 1.6mm, 160x160mm: TOP = square patch + etched 90deg branch-line coupler + 2 microstrip feeds (+ inset notches), soldermask keep-out over all RF copper; BOTTOM = ground. SMA edge footprint + 50ohm resistor pad + 3x M3 mounting holes
notes: ~25-45 EUR/5 incl ship+VAT. ALL RF geometry etched (reproducible) - no air, no probe, no slot. 160mm=256cm2, cheap tier. 160mm chosen for MAX AR<=3 beamwidth (52deg vs 28deg at 190 - smaller GP = wider beam); it is the coupler-limited floor. NP-140F guaranteed-if-picked = known er -> resonance lands on bench. RHCP from the coupler, not the patch.

spec: edge/end-launch SMA jack, 50 ohm DC-6GHz, for a 1.6mm board edge: center pin lands on the top 50ohm microstrip, ground saddle wraps to the bottom GP, no through-board via. THIS is the microstrip launch. Vertical PCB jack = OK fallback (needs a launch pad + ground vias)
notes: Edge-launch = clean microstrip launch (no via, ideal for the edge feed); very forgiving at 869MHz. Reichelt stocks no true edge-launch -> order the Wuerth/Adafruit edge-launch, OR use the BKL vertical jack with a launch pad + ground vias. One per board.

spec: 50 ohm thin-film, 0402/0603, terminates the coupler isolated port
notes: The ONLY SMD part besides the SMA. Goes on the branch-line's isolated 4th port (with a ground via). Use a real 50ohm, not a 49.9 if you can - either is fine.
